message: Binder Error: Referenced column "pd_12_month" not found in FROM clause!
submitted_code: SELECT facility_id, pd_12_month FROM cockpit_facility_quarter WHERE reporting_quarter = '2026Q2' AND sector_code = 'F41'

available_alternatives.meaning: Point-in-time probability of default over the next 12 months.
Through-the-cycle 12-month PD on the documented horizon.
The actual remaining horizon underlying the lifetime PD. Not automatically twenty quarters and not the reporting calendar.
PIT 12-month PD at initial recognition, the SICR comparison baseline.
TTC 12-month PD at initial recognition, where supplied.
Source parameter version for the PD values.

relevant_grains.cockpit_borrower_financial_quarter: borrower_id x reporting_quarter x statement_scope -- BORROWER grain. One borrower may secure several facilities; joining this to cockpit_facility_quarter repeats the statement once per facility
relevant_grains.cockpit_collateral_allocation: collateral_id x facility_id x position_id x reporting_quarter -- the allocation link. Summing gross_market_value across this relation double counts a shared asset
relevant_grains.cockpit_collateral_quarter: collateral_id x reporting_quarter -- ASSET grain. An asset shared across facilities appears ONCE here
relevant_grains.cockpit_covenant_quarter: covenant_id x reporting_quarter x test_version -- obligation grain. A borrower-wide covenant must not be counted once per facility
relevant_grains.cockpit_facility_quarter: tenant_id x dataset_release_id x reporting_quarter x facility_id x position_id -- one atomic facility position per reporting quarter
relevant_grains.cockpit_ifrs9_detail: facility position x reporting_quarter x ifrs9_run_id x scenario_id x term_horizon_index -- stored IFRS 9 parameters and results only
relevant_grains.cockpit_macro_quarter_window: reporting_quarter (anchor) x factor_id x country_or_region x scenario_id x quarter_offset (-4..+15) -- 20 offsets per anchor
relevant_grains.cockpit_qualitative_quarter: borrower_id x reporting_quarter x question_id -- twenty rows per borrower-quarter when fully answered
relevant_grains.cockpit_rating_ratio_quarter: borrower_id x reporting_quarter x rating_basis -- BORROWER grain, same repetition warning as the financial statements

suggested_clarification: If the request did not say which, ask whether the user means the point-in-time or the through-the-cycle PD, and the twelve-month or the lifetime horizon. Do not substitute one silently.
